title: Style is Everything
description:
Once per Scene, when you **do something in an unnecessarily dramatic manner**, mark a Condition and reset Panache to equal your cha.

When you **Trade Blows** using a **precise** weapon, you can spend 1 Panache to roll+cha (instead of +dex).

title: Fly Into the Face of Danger
description: When you **Defy Danger** by attempting something you've never tried before, you may spend 1 Panache to roll with adv.

outcomes.text: When you **Trade Blows**, you can spend 1 Panache to do one of the following:
bullets: Disarm — ✴On a 10+, you can choose to have your opponent drop something they're holding (instead of the other choices)
Feint — ✴On a 10+, you can choose to grant yourself a small window of opportunity to act unimpeded (instead of the other choices)
Parry — ✴On a 6-, when an opponent inflicts max dmg to you, you can block the dmg
Riposte — When an opponent inflicts 1 dmg to you (or less), you can inflict your dmg in return

title: Very Intricate Backstory
description: You can have two Struggles active at the same time. Now or the next time you **Make Camp**, clear a locked Condition (if possible) or **Level Up** and Reveal a Struggle.

title: Watch Me Shine
description: When you **draw attention by doing something unnecessarily dramatic**, spend 1 Panache to roll+dex.

bullets: Defuse or intensify a situation (your call)
Your allies are ignored; they get an opportunity
Your drama isn't interrupted, by word or by violence

outcomes.text: The attention is followed by violent action; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
